entries.title: Luke 21:1
segments: ¶And looking up, he saw the men of wealth putting their offerings in the money-box.

entries.title: Luke 21:2
segments: And he saw a certain poor widow putting in a farthing.

entries.title: Luke 21:3
segments: And he said, Truly I say to you, This poor widow has given more than all of them:

entries.title: Luke 21:4
segments: For they gave out of their wealth, having more than enough for themselves: but she, even out of her need, has put in all her living.

entries.title: Luke 21:5
segments: ¶And some were talking about the Temple, how it was made fair with beautiful stones and with offerings, but he said,

entries.title: Luke 21:6
segments: As for these things which you see, the days will come when not one stone will be resting on another, but all will be broken down.

entries.title: Luke 21:7
segments: And they said to him, Master, when will these things be? and what sign will there be when these events are to take place?

entries.title: Luke 21:8
segments: And he said, Take care that you are not tricked: for a number of people will come in my name, saying, I am he; and, The time is near: do not go after them.

entries.title: Luke 21:9
segments: And when news of wars and troubled times comes to your ears, have no fear; for these things have to be, but the end will not be now.

entries.title: Luke 21:10
segments: Then he said to them, Nation will be moved against nation and kingdom against kingdom:

entries.title: Luke 21:11
segments: There will be great earth-shocks and outbursts of disease in a number of places, and men will be without food; and there will be wonders and great signs from heaven.

entries.title: Luke 21:12
segments: But before all this, they will take you and be very cruel to you, giving you up to the Synagogues and to prisons, taking you before kings and rulers, because of my name.

entries.title: Luke 21:13
segments: And it will be turned to a witness for you.

entries.title: Luke 21:14
segments: So take care not to be troubled before the time comes, about what answers you will give:

entries.title: Luke 21:15
segments: For I will give you words and wisdom, so that not one of those who are against you will be able to get the better of you, or to put you in the wrong.

entries.title: Luke 21:16
segments: But you will be given up even by your fathers and mothers, your brothers and relations and friends; and some of you will be put to death.

entries.title: Luke 21:17
segments: And you will be hated by all men, because of me.

entries.title: Luke 21:18
segments: But not a hair of your head will come to destruction.

entries.title: Luke 21:19
segments: By going through all these things, you will keep your lives.

entries.title: Luke 21:20
segments: ¶But when you see armies all round about Jerusalem, then be certain that her destruction is near.

entries.title: Luke 21:21
segments: Then let those who are in Judaea go in flight to the mountains; and those who are in the middle of the town go out; and let not those who are in the country come in.

entries.title: Luke 21:22
segments: For these are the days of punishment, in which all the things in the Writings will be put into effect.

entries.title: Luke 21:23
segments: It will be hard for women who are with child, and for her with a baby at the breast, in those days. For great trouble will come on the land, and wrath on this people.

entries.title: Luke 21:24
segments: And they will be put to death with the sword, and will be taken as prisoners into all the nations; and Jerusalem will be crushed under the feet of the Gentiles, till the times of the Gentiles are complete.

entries.title: Luke 21:25
segments: And there will be signs in the sun and moon and stars; and on the earth, fear among the nations and doubt because of the loud noise of the sea and the waves;

entries.title: Luke 21:26
segments: Men's strength will go from them in fear and in waiting for the things which are coming on the earth; for the powers of the heavens will be moved.

entries.title: Luke 21:27
segments: And then they will see the Son of man coming in a cloud, with power and great glory.

entries.title: Luke 21:28
segments: But when these things come about, let your heads be lifted up, because your salvation is near.

entries.title: Luke 21:29
segments: ¶And he made a story for them: See the fig-tree, and all the trees;

entries.title: Luke 21:30
segments: When they put out their young leaves, you take note of it, and it is clear to you that summer is coming.

entries.title: Luke 21:31
segments: In the same way, when you see these things taking place you may be certain that the kingdom of God is near.

entries.title: Luke 21:32
segments: Truly I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all things are complete.

entries.title: Luke 21:33
segments: Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.

entries.title: Luke 21:34
segments: But give attention to yourselves, for fear that your hearts become over-full of the pleasures of food and wine, and the cares of this life, and that day may come on you suddenly, and take you as in a net:

entries.title: Luke 21:35
segments: For so it will come on all those who are living on the face of all the earth.

entries.title: Luke 21:36
segments: But keep watch at all times with prayer, that you may be strong enough to come through all these things and take your place before the Son of man.

entries.title: Luke 21:37
segments: And every day he was teaching in the Temple and every night he went out to the mountain which is named the Mountain of Olives to take his rest.

entries.title: Luke 21:38
segments: And all the people came early in the morning to give ear to his words in the Temple.
